verdict.rationale: Mastra is a workflow and agent framework with a server and Cloud deployment, so per-workflow, per-key or per-tenant concurrency caps and rate limits are a fair axis to ask about. Nothing in the evidence documents concurrency limits, rate limiting, quotas or tenant isolation. Retries, guardrails and observability are related but different features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I cap concurrency and set rate limits per workflow, per key, or per tenant so one hot customer can't starve the rest
